Consent.Headline: “{0}” wants to connect to this Mac
Consent.Intro: If you allow, they can see and use this Mac with the permissions you select. Deny if you don't recognize them.
Consent.FingerprintLabel: Their key fingerprint (to check it, ask them to read out “This Mac's fingerprint” from their window)
Consent.Takeover: This Mac is being controlled by another device. If you allow, that session will end.
Consent.PermClipboard: Sync clipboard (what is copied on either side is shared)
Consent.PermAudio: Send sound (sound playing on this Mac plays on their side)
Consent.PermFile: Transfer files (only the side that has a file can send it)
Consent.SaveDevice: Remember this device (no code needed next time, but you still confirm)
Consent.SkipNextTime: Don't ask again when this device connects
Consent.SkipNextTimeNote: When on, they can connect even while you are away from the computer; a banner always stays at the top of the screen.
Consent.InputAvailable: Can move the mouse, click and type
Consent.InputUnavailable: NexaDesk does not have Accessibility permission on this Mac, so keyboard and mouse cannot be allowed
Consent.FileNote: Both sides can send each other files, and received files are saved in {0}; they cannot browse files on this Mac
Consent.Countdown: Denied automatically if there is no answer within {0} s
Consent.HeadlineBrowser: The browser “{0}” wants to connect to this Mac
Consent.BrowserNote: This is a web browser, not the NexaDesk app. It can only see the screen and use the keyboard and mouse. It is never saved: it needs a one-time code every time.
